author: Davish
body:
Before I get into this I just wanna tell you; whoever is reading this; that I guess there's no disrespect intended in this one because I'm just telling it like it is, that being said if you'd like to start an intellectual debate over what I say here, I'll be happy to oblige. Who knows though, maybe my suggestions below might help the server in the long run? 
Ok so I guess I'll tell you why I hacked anyways.
I've noticed that the server sees about 10-20 hackers on a daily basis, and so I wondered why it was so appealing to do it, and to my amusement, I've concluded that the server has a pretty terrible anti-cheat system. I wasn't even prevented from using Fly (by the way, the client I used was Wurst, and if you shift to the ground while using the Fly hack you take fall damage). I actually find this hilarious... All servers that don't want fly hackers should have an anti-cheat system, hell, even 2b2t, an anarchy server that ALLOWS hacks has an anti-fly system. I don't really care that much about getting unbanned really, I've gotten a bit bored with the server, especially with the hackers and such, anyway, guys I seriously think you should consider getting an ant-cheat system that prevents fly hacking, and honestly there's no excuse as to why you don't have one already.
Thanks, have a good day, and smell ya later!

title: Meh, so this is a more "Respectful" Appeal?

replies.author: Acceqted
replies.body:
Hey there,

I commend you and appreciate your time to make a more respectful appeal. 

1. Regarding all your comments toward implementing an anti cheat. We have shown away from it due to the possibility of it banning our more competitve players who are sometimes mistaken. We do not want to handle all the appeals regarding false bans as its more unneeded work for us. It is not only for our, but at the same time your convienece.

2. I'll give you the benefit of the doubt and I'll remind us all, to keep on top of our hack detection. But seeing as you admitted to hacking, you'll remain punished, and you may appeal in 6-8 months. I highly suggest you don't ban evade [Logging onto an alternate account while avoiding your current punishment on a different account in your hands]. Thank you for taking the time to appeal, but this appeal is denied.

Thank you for your time, Josh/Acceqted

*I'll leave this open for 24 hours for you to understand what will happen and a senior to check over*
